exposure: COVID-19 pandemic period (pre-pandemic vs. during pandemic)
outcome: mode of delivery (cesarean and operative vaginal)
cohort: The study included 105,458 deliveries to adolescent and young adult (AYA) mothers in Texas.
finding: Overall adolescent and young adult (AYA) deliveries decreased significantly from the pre-pandemic to during the pandemic periods, with notable shifts in maternal demographics, health conditions, and delivery outcomes including mode of delivery and pregnancy complications.
mod_finding: The incidence of cesarean and operative vaginal deliveries was significantly lower during the pandemic compared to the pre-pandemic period.
